description: Figure 6 presents a breakdown of token distribution for Federated Hierarchical Learning Machines (FedHLM) across Local, Peer-to-Peer (P2P), and Large Language Model (LLM) resolutions. The pie chart is divided into three slices: Local, P2P, and LLM Resolution. The Local slice is colored light gray and represents 94.5% of the total distribution. The P2P slice is colored medium gray and accounts for approximately 3.9% of the distribution. Finally, the LLM Resolution slice is colored dark gray and represents 1.6% of the distribution. The chart includes a legend identifying each slice by name and color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, proceeding clockwise from Local to LLM Resolution.
